$description: Fugleramme border, radius, and shadow tokens. Vintage aesthetic is angular — minimal rounding. Shadows are warm-toned (sepia-brown tints, never cool grey).

radius.$description: Border radii. The display view is angular/vintage; the dashboard may use very slight rounding for modern affordance.

none.$note: Strictly square corners. Use on all display-view frames, vintage illustration borders, and the Hero Button.

xs.$note: Barely perceptible rounding. Use on dashboard input fields and small chips where hard edges feel too stark.

sm.$note: Subtle rounding. Use on dashboard cards and panels only.

md.$note: Moderate rounding. Reserved for modals and overlays in the dashboard where softness aids focus.

full.$note: Pill/circle. Use only for status indicator dots and avatar thumbnails.

medium.$note: Emphasis borders, active states, focus rings

double.$note: CSS double border — used on vintage frame outer edge

vintage.$description: Composed border definitions for the Fugleramme display frame (US-004). These produce the hand-cut illustration aesthetic.

frameOuter.$note: Outermost double-line frame. CSS 'double' renders as two lines with a gap between — classic vintage look.

frameInner.$note: Inner accent line. Uses paper-500 (warm aged gold) for a subtle gilded-line effect between outer and canvas.

frameCornerInset.$note: Additional inset to create the gap between the double outer border and the inner accent line.

illustrationBorder.$note: Subtle hairline around each cut-out bird illustration. Mimics the hand-cut paper edge.

dashboard.$description: Border definitions for the functional dashboard (US-003).

inputBorderFocus.$note: Focus state — wider, forest green. Visible keyboard focus indicator.

heroBorder.$note: Hero Button has no border — relies on background colour contrast only (no border needed at 11.8:1)

shadow.$description: Box shadows. All shadows use warm sepia tones, never neutral grey. Values are CSS box-shadow strings.

xs.$note: Hairline lift — subtle card depth. Warm sepia tint.

md.$note: Medium shadow — elevated cards, Hero Button

frame.$note: Vintage display frame shadow. Combines a subtle inner inset with a rich outer drop shadow to create depth and authenticity.

heroButton.$note: Hero Button shadow — forest green tint to echo the button fill colour.

insetPressed.$note: Active/pressed state — element appears depressed into surface

illustrationFloat.$note: Subtle cast shadow beneath each bird illustration on the display canvas. Mimics cut paper floating on the page.

focusRing.$description: Focus visible outlines for keyboard accessibility. Ensure all interactive elements apply these.

default.$note: Forest green focus ring. Must be applied on :focus-visible on ALL interactive elements.

onDark.$note: Light focus ring for use on dark green surfaces (Hero Button)
